infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CLUTRL uses your camera to scan hunt QR codes and capture AR moments.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CLUTRL uses your location during Live and Immersive hunts so your Hunt Master can follow progress and place AR discoveries.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow CLUTRL to scan target QR codes and capture hunt moments.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow CLUTRL to record video hunt moments.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow CLUTRL to share your location while a Live or Immersive hunt is active.
